mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS quizId, q.code, q.title, q.description, q.cover_url AS coverUrl, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM game_poet_quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = q.id AND status = 1) AS questionCount FROM game_poet_quiz q WHERE q.status = 1 ORDER BY q.sort_no ASC, q.id ASC
SELECT id AS quizId, title, description, cover_url AS coverUrl FROM game_poet_quiz WHERE id = #{quizId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS questionId, question_no AS questionNo, question_text AS questionText FROM game_poet_quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY question_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id AS optionId, option_no AS optionNo, option_text AS optionText FROM game_poet_quiz_option WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY option_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM game_poet_quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_poet_quiz_attempt( user_id, quiz_id, total_questions, answered_count, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{quizId}, #{totalQuestions}, #{answeredCount}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, quiz_id AS quizId, total_questions AS totalQuestions, answered_count AS answeredCount, status, result_poet_id AS resultPoetId, result_score AS resultScore, result_scores_snapshot AS resultScoresSnapshot, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM game_poet_quiz_attempt WHERE id = #{attemptId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE game_poet_quiz_attempt SET answered_count = #{answeredCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{attemptId}

UPDATE game_poet_quiz_attempt SET status = 'finished', result_poet_id = #{resultPoetId}, result_score = #{resultScore}, result_scores_snapshot = #{resultScoresSnapshot}, finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{attemptId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, question_id AS questionId, option_no AS optionNo, option_text AS optionText, status FROM game_poet_quiz_option WHERE id = #{optionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS poetId, p.name AS name, p.dynasty AS dynasty, p.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, IFNULL(t.score, 0) AS score FROM game_poet_profile p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT os.poet_id AS poet_id, SUM(os.score) AS score FROM game_poet_quiz_answer a JOIN game_poet_quiz_option_score os ON os.option_id = a.option_id WHERE a.attempt_id = #{attemptId} GROUP BY os.poet_id ) t ON t.poet_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY score DESC, p.sort_no ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT id AS poetId, name, dynasty, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, persona_title AS personaTitle, persona_desc AS personaDesc, representative_works AS representativeWorks, tags FROM game_poet_profile WHERE id = #{poetId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS poetId, name, dynasty, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, persona_title AS personaTitle, persona_desc AS personaDesc, representative_works AS representativeWorks, tags FROM game_poet_profile WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
